jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (React/Tailwind)
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Frontend Engineer to build and scale high-performance web applications. You will collaborate closely with UI/UX designers and backend engineers to create smooth mobile-first shopping experiences for Ghanaian businesses.
jobs.requirements:
• 3+ years experience with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS
• Strong grasp of responsive mobile design and performance optimization
• Experience with state management and RESTful APIs
• Passion for building accessible software

jobs.title: Retail Operations & Inventory Manager
jobs.description: Lead day-to-day warehouse logistics, stock replenishment, and multi-channel fulfillment across retail stores in Adum and Kejetia. Coordinate dispatch drivers and ensure accurate reconciliation in SellerFlow POS.
jobs.requirements:
• Diploma or Degree in Business, Supply Chain, or Accounting
• 2+ years retail store or warehouse supervisory experience
• Proficiency with digital inventory systems and Excel
• Strong leadership and conflict resolution skills

jobs.title: Digital Marketing & Social Media Lead
jobs.description: Drive organic growth and paid campaigns on TikTok, Instagram, and SellerFlow for local and diaspora brands. Create short-form video content, craft brand messaging, and optimize conversion funnels.
jobs.requirements:
• Proven portfolio of successful social campaigns in Ghana/West Africa
• Hands-on video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or Canva)
• Analytical mindset with Meta & Google Ads dashboard proficiency

jobs.title: Logistics & Fleet Dispatch Coordinator
jobs.description: Coordinate motorcycle couriers and light trucks for last-mile merchant deliveries across Sekondi-Takoradi and Tarkwa. Monitor GPS tracking and resolve delivery delays with exceptional customer service.
jobs.requirements:
• WASSCE or HND with dispatch routing experience
• Excellent verbal communication in English and Fante/Twi
• Familiarity with mobile delivery apps and courier routing

events.title: Ghana E-Commerce & Retail Innovation Summit 2026
events.description: Join 350+ verified merchants, software engineers, fintech executives, and logistics leaders across Ghana. Highlights include live keynotes on cross-border AfCFTA trade, mobile money automation, fraud prevention, and networking exhibitions.

events.title: Accra Tech Founders & Builders Mixer
events.description: An evening of peer networking for software engineers, product designers, and venture-backed startup operators in Ghana. Speed pitching, investor Q&A, craft appetizers, and tech demo tables.

events.title: Kumasi Made-in-Ghana Pop-Up Marketplace
events.description: Over 80 local designers, food entrepreneurs, and craft artisans showcase their products in a vibrant open-air market. Features live highlife music, local cuisine tastings, and instant cashless checkout powered by SellerFlow.
